<AppOnly>

Widgets render on the server by default. Wrap slow ones in `<Suspense>`.

</AppOnly>

<PagesOnly>

In the Pages Router, load widget data with `getStaticProps`.

</PagesOnly>

## Install

```bash filename="Terminal"
# add the package
npm install widgets
```

## Usage

```tsx filename="app/page.tsx" switcher
import { Widget } from 'widgets'

export default function Page() {
  return <Widget size="small" />
}
```

> **Good to know**: a widget adds less than 2 KB of JavaScript. Details at <https://example.com/widgets>.

### Example

Pass `size` as `"small"` or `"large"`.

## Usage with forms

### Example

Read the current value with `useWidget()`.
